data.jarvisResponse:
Ah, repeating myself? I suppose even the most refined wit can be subject to an encore if the audience insists. 

"I told my doctor that I broke my arm in two places. He told me to stop going to those places."

A bit pedestrian for my usual standards, but it seems to have tickled your fancy. Shall we move on to something more stimulating, or are you hoping for a third rendition?
